title: Correct μ₂ value
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for part (1) must be μ₂ = 0.4.

title: Correct F(x) expression
description: Essential: The final expression for part (2) must be F = μ₁Mg(L-x)/L or its equivalent.

title: Force balance for dictionary
description: Important: The solution must equate the friction from the paper on the dictionary to the friction between the dictionary and the table for the threshold of motion.

title: Normal force from pressure distribution
description: Important: For part (2), the normal force on the paper must be correctly derived from the linear pressure distribution, resulting in F_N proportional to (L-x).

title: Mass above paper calculation
description: Important: For part (1), the mass m of the dictionary section above the paper must be found using the linear proportion m = M(H-h)/H.

title: Friction force on paper
description: Important: The friction force on the A4 paper must account for both the top and bottom surfaces (factor of 2) and use μ₁.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All calculations should maintain consistent units (e.g., cm to m conversion) or the final expression should be dimensionally correct.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the force balance incorrectly assigns directions, leading to a sign error in the final expression.

title: Incorrect normal force model
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the normal force in part (2) is assumed constant (e.g., Mg/2) instead of varying linearly with the overlap length (L-x).
